other_inputs.used_for: 3-d.p. check of every plotted value against tab:warm, tab:xni, tab:r3a; margins 0.0141 / 0.01065 / 0.01245 and retention threshold -0.010 (Sec. Evaluation Protocol)
fig_overview unit (role test_ouhdl B1, the unit of the v11 overview)

method: No value is recomputed. Each graph plots delta, ci_lo, ci_hi exactly as stored in the source CSV (paired difference on common units, 95% percentile bootstrap interval; interval construction as described in v11 Sec. Evaluation Protocol). The data CSVs are written first and the figures are drawn from them.

columns.n_ft_seeds_arm: fine-tuning seeds of the arm (source column n_train_seeds_arm)
columns.reference_line: margin or threshold drawn for this metric
columns.source_row: row filter in the source file
columns.v11_location: where the value appears in v11
columns.v11_value: value printed in the v11 table
columns.in_v11_table: value is in a v11 table
columns.matches_v11_3dp: source value, lo and hi each within 0.0005 of the v11 table

headers: Units 1–3: warm adaptation against plain fine-tuning

Units 4, 5: selection among 3 samples
Unit 6: English, no router

figure_notes.fig_gain: 15 intervals: WFT, WFT-PE (tab:warm, 10 values) and the SFT control for 5 metrics. The 5 control values are NOT in a v11 table: AIoU +0.0141 [+0.0129, +0.0153] is in the v11 text (Encoder versus extra steps), the other four are in the source file only. Control has 2 fine-tuning seeds (source evidence_label NOT_ASSESSED), drawn with open markers. Margins drawn at -0.0141, -0.01065, -0.01245; Kendall tau has no margin (reported, not gated). Round 3: value labels added for WFT and WFT-PE on the pen-up F1 and strict-order rows (formatted from fig_gain_data.csv delta, 3 d.p.); x-axis upper limit 0.135 -> 0.14 to hold the label.
figure_notes.fig_retention: 24 intervals (tab:xni AIoU and direction). Panel widths are proportional to the axis ranges, so one unit of difference has the same length in both panels. Retention threshold -0.010 gates AIoU only; the direction margin -0.01245 is drawn as a reference. tab:german values (0.881 / 0.889 against 0.955) are not plotted: they are unit-weighted absolute scores and differ from the paired deltas of tab:xni.
figure_notes.fig_selector: 10 intervals (tab:r3a pen-up F1 and strict order, n = 4,406). Margins 0.0141 and 0.01065 drawn (order-gain criterion: point estimate beyond the margin, interval above zero). Round 3: line labels read "selection-gain margin" (was "order-gain margin").
figure_notes.fig_overview: Redrawn: script routing, two models (warm-adapted model, warm backbone), k = 3 samples, Endpoint Consensus Selection, warm-adaptation training lane. Frame-choice box and C1-C3 labels removed. Round 3 (lettering): all text 8 pt in the figure = 6.2 pt at 0.85 text width; the f_not_t symbol and its subscript were dropped; component titles bold; lane arrows now drawn above the lane background; "other inputs" follows the v12 caption. Every boxed label lies inside its box (box_overflow empty), 0 text overlaps. Routing colour #CC79A7.
figure_notes.unchanged: fig_frame_verifier and fig_metric not regenerated (staged v11 PDFs, cluster paper/figs_v11/figs; sha256 prefixes f49c10ca576c, 959f9dcbd87b): pdftotext grep for 'step-matched', 'Label-Free', 'Order Selection', 'C1'-'C3', 'RQ1'-'RQ3', 'verifier' gives 0 matches in each. fig_retention not redrawn in round 3.
figure_notes.fig_warm: Round 3: redrawn natively (no longer a substitution of the v11 function) with the v12 wording: "warm adaptation" (was "warm fine-tune"), "source datasets" (was "non-target scripts"), "continued source training" with the header "four 10,000-step milestones, one kept" (was "+40k steps"), "source-training control" kept. Wording source: lead instruction and paper_inkbridge_v12.tex Sec. Warm Adaptation (cluster paper/ijdar_v12, sha256 2414bd9a...). All text 8 pt (schedule labels 10 pt) = 6.2 pt at 0.85 text width.
